description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ThingIdNotExplicitlySettableException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception is thrown when an attempt is made to set a Thing ID explicitly in a JSON body during REST POST or PUT requests, which is disallowed. The class includes static factory methods for creating exception instances for different scenarios (POST, PUT, and Ditto protocol), as well as a builder pattern for constructing exception objects with rich context.
